fusions.name: Mile-End Kick
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, sets it [Burning] for 5 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Smouldering Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps a 4-tile trail of burning ground ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 6 damage to each enemy that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Coalwalk
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 25% for 10 seconds, freeing you of every root, freeze and slow. You have 25% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Embers
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover flings an ember at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
